page.overview:
Who is Edarna Noregovna?

Her name could indicate a Kandori origin, given the ending of her surname being prominent in Kandori names.

Edarna held the position for fifty-one years until her death in , the longest Amyrlin's reign during this era. She was Dalaine Ndaye's successor and Balladare Arandaille's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was a strong Amyrlin. It is thought she was one of the most politically skilled women to ever hold the staff and stole.
